- **Impaired focus and coordination:** Both substances affect the central nervous system, which can slow reaction times and impair judgment.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXiV7w0Dnrp7dHnR0DUWfihizGGmCDD9bOk9bC1falf1SMGOHOFcq3srmtAUJ164LKdlOCBVxoQ22uJAMWe3Ee9QN8Uq8GAq9FQ1ab3DlcFzdnn76p0Damtmp8R43gjhKdia0gukKiManLR9g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF1_G-HZB-FQDfV_ELTZ7jVHqG_Ggluo1wANUC3fLowwFrGmRYE2U7znJ5Ufh0DgNagt08BK6gpnSTMOOVSmEbwksFqGVdUkagaS5QYkrbOjCPVovSK1wqgL61m0C76AWZV2EBaobruU4FFOlT1-x9UDJHsQZEgeLKU-3YFg95Q9_KuX8GmohERGoyVg4vRe0sY7iM6Iq-_TRqIjd_Gm5cXhRiPf0hqavOw_E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1wAMH2QmlWn18mgfoK0EZxGpOG0UNhUtmSr-BMxyW1Xq3rY8Qi7cYNfF9cLmfyr5zummJm4QTe1hMriyIDp3tGWdi0WB2AQ2OO18f6ftt0O_djF4Q-9dASIhCU9O2Jcndj5Dgahum1rRlwO88H2JxGGB3_SewcDTbLoWyb__ePBULQPIn1ss1qwr5ctp)
